rows.note: This is the all-purpose modifier for things relating to a person's vocation or occupation.

example.english: This centre provides vocational counselling to help people plan their careers.
example.traditional: 呢間中心提供職業輔導，幫人規劃工作路向。
example.jyutping: ni1 gaan1 zung1 sam1 tai4 gung1 zik1 jip6 fu6 dou6 bong1 jan4 kwai1 waak6 gung1 zok3 lou6 hoeng3

rows.note: Use this specifically for education that teaches practical job skills rather than academic knowledge.

example.english: This school focuses on vocational education and teaches students a practical trade.
example.traditional: 呢間學校以職業教育為主，教學生一門實用手藝。
example.jyutping: ne1 gaan1 hok6 haau6 ji5 zik1 jip6 gaau3 juk6 wai4 zyu2 gaau3 hok6 saang1 jat1 mun4 sat6 jung6 sau2 ngai6
